description: Get the full directory profile for one specific producer by its slug, including location, declared honey types, contact channels, and verification status. Use this after find_local_producers (or search) when the user wants more detail on a particular listing. Don't use this to browse or search — it requires an exact producer slug.

slug.description: The exact producer slug, as returned in the slug/id field of a find_local_producers or search result, e.g. 'cloister-honey', 'asheville-bee-charmer'.

name: get_producer
